repo_notes.content: ekklesiaONLINE is a multi‑parish web application designed to streamline administrative tasks for parishes, dioceses and provinces in the Episcopal Church. Each parish has its own administrators (clergy, vestry members[Senior and Junior Guardians, clerk, treasurer], ministry leaders) who manage only their parish’s data. Diocesan bishop and bishops’ staff have read-only access to all parishes in their diocese. The system supports member management, service attendance tracking, financial record-keeping, volunteer coordination, and visitor follow-up.
